subject: Vendor setup & PO mapping — Northfield Corp AP requirements
messages:
From: Oliver Grant <oliver.grant@northfieldcorp.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood-inference.com>
Cc: AP Team <ap@northfieldcorp.com>
Date: 2027-04-18T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Redwood vendor setup + PO requirements

Hi Ben,

Can you help us get Redwood set up as a vendor in Northfield's AP system? Finance needs the vendor packet and a clear list of what must be present on invoices for automated PO matching. Specifically:
- Company legal name and remit address to appear on invoices
- Tax IDs (TIN/VAT) and any W-9/W-8 forms for our records
- Bank details and whether you accept ACH / wire / virtual card
- Any required fields for our PO -> invoice 1:1 matching (PO number placement, line-level SKU mapping, service dates)
- Preferred invoice delivery method (email to ap-invoices@northfieldcorp.com or EDI)

We have an internal requirement for PO header in the invoice and the PO number in the EDI BEG02 element if submitting via EDI. Also let us know if you need exceptions for milestone invoices or consolidated billing.

Appreciate a packet and sample invoice if possible — we have a tight onboarding window.

Thanks,
Oliver
Accounts Payable Liaison
Northfield Corporation

From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood-inference.com>
To: Oliver Grant <oliver.grant@northfieldcorp.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood-inference.com>, AP Team <ap@northfieldcorp.com>
Date: 2027-04-18T11:05:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Redwood vendor setup + PO requirements

Hi Oliver — thanks for the clear list. Attaching the Redwood supplier packet and our standard W-9 plus bank details to this thread. High level answers below; see attachments for the formal forms and a sample invoice PDF.

Key items for Northfield to consume:
- Legal name: Redwood Inference, Inc.
- Remit address (for paper/PO records): 1201 Inference Way, Suite 300, San Francisco, CA 94107
- Tax: U.S. EIN: XX-XXXXXXX (W-9 attached). For EU customers we supply VAT registration details if applicable — we can provide certificate on request.
- Bank: ACH and wire supported. Bank details file attached (Redwood_Bank_Details.csv). We do not take virtual card for enterprise deals by default; can accept on case-by-case basis — let us know if Northfield requires a card program.
- Invoice requirements for PO matching:
  - PO number must be in invoice header and in the invoice metadata field labeled "PO Number" (plain text).
  - For EDI: include PO number in BEG segment (BEG02).
  - Include billing contact and invoice-level total. Line-level descriptions should include service month and product variant (model name/version) to help your cost-center mapping.
  - If Northfield does three-way match, include invoice date, invoice number, and service period on each line.

Preferred delivery: PDF invoice to ap-invoices@redwood-inference.com OR SFTP drop; we can accept EDI 850/810 if you share your EDI endpoint.

Exceptions & consolidated billing: We can support consolidated monthly billing by cost center provided we receive a PO for each cost center or reference mapping file; milestone invoices (e.g., implementation fees tied to milestone) can be routed without PO if approved in advance — provide a PO exception email address and we will coordinate.

Next steps:
1) Confirm whether Northfield will send POs via EDI or web portal.
2) If EDI, share endpoint and sample BEG framing.
3) We'll return signed supplier packet and a sample invoice annotated with PO mapping.

Ben Carter
Enterprise Sales
Redwood Inference
ben.carter@redwood-inference.com
+1 415 555 0192

Attachments: Redwood_Supplier_Profile.xlsx, Redwood_W9.pdf, Redwood_Bank_Details.csv

Thanks Ben — that is helpful. A couple follow-ups from AP:
1) Please confirm the remittance email address we should display on the invoice for automated uploads.
2) Provide your vendor tax classification (for US: corporation, partnership, etc.) to complete our vendor record.
3) Can you add a single-line "Cost Center" custom field on the invoice PDF so our import can map rows?

Also, Northfield prefers to send POs via our procurement portal (no EDI initially). We will create a vendor record only after we receive the supplier packet + W-9 + bank ACH info. If onboarding completes this week we can issue the initial PO by next Friday.

Oliver

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood-inference.com>

Subject: Re: Redwood vendor setup + PO requirements

Hi Oliver — Marissa on Finance here, copying Ben.

Answers inline:
1) Remittance email for automated uploads: ap-invoices@redwood-inference.com (please whitelist). If Northfield requires a remit-to address for XML mapping, use: remit@redwood-inference.com (internal alias).
2) Tax classification: C-Corporation. W-9 provided in the earlier attachment. If you need a W-8 for an offshore entity within Northfield, let us know which legal entity and we will provide the corresponding form.
3) We can add a single-line "Cost Center" field on the invoice PDF and include it as an optional invoice metadata field for your import. When you create the vendor record in the portal, provide the custom field name so we can align it.

Additional notes:
- Invoice header must include: Invoice number, Invoice date, PO number, Company legal name, Remit address, and our VAT/EIN as applicable.
- For consolidated billing: include mapping CSV (we can accept a mapping CSV in the invoice zip) with columns (PO Number, Cost Center, Amount).

Attached again: Redwood_Supplier_Profile.xlsx (filled), Redwood_W9.pdf, Redwood_Bank_Details.csv, and a sample annotated invoice (Sample_Invoice_Northfield.pdf).

If Northfield needs our CP external ID for AP automation, it will be issued after your vendor record is created; share the vendor ID and we will confirm mapping.

Best,
Marissa Cole
Manager, Revenue Operations
Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood-inference.com

Marissa — perfect, that gives us everything to create the vendor record.

Action items from Northfield:
- AP will create vendor record by 2027-04-22 and send vendor ID + portal access to Ben.
- Procurement will issue a portal PO (header PO) by 2027-04-23; they indicated Net 45 payment terms by default. We may need a negotiated Net 30 for this initial pilot. Can Redwood confirm Net 30 vs Net 45? If Net 30 is acceptable, procurement can prioritize the PO issuance.
- We will use the Cost Center field name "NF_COST_CENTER" in the portal — please map that to your invoice metadata field.

Thanks for the quick turnaround. We'll be in touch once the vendor ID is created.

Oliver
